datadog.limitation: Retry attempts are not extra HTTP requests. Matching final outcomes for each individual retry were not correlated in this investigation.

durableAudit.limitation: Audit does not retain the rejected timestamp or clock provenance; no attribution of these 18 failures to device clocks was established.

retrospectivePlayback.limitation: This does not erase known older deployment/Redis failures or prove future availability.

deployedObservation.limitation: Latest build metadata is not proof of serving revision. Diagnostic window spans earlier deployments.

confirmed: Valid capability plus client clock outside the signed event-time interval yields timestamp rejection.
Genuinely expired capability fails before timestamp audit.
Terminal synthetic evidence rejection is not retried by the component.
Production startup readiness can return 200 while Redis rate-limit store operations reject; connected/recovered control passes.
limits: Redis availability test substitutes callback errors; no real Redis restart or complete Yoga mutation is executed.
Web clock test simulates the independently tested Admin timestamp predicate.
No full current-pointer audit, new production browser canary, or alert installation performed.
